questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Poverty and overcrowding are ruining the life of people in many big cities.
options: A. To make poverty and overcrowding even worse, people in many big cities ruin their life.
B. Due to poverty and overcrowding, the life of people in many big cities is being ruined.
C. Unless there are poverty and overcrowding, the life of people in many big cities won't be ruined.
D. Despite poverty and overcrowding, the life of people in many big cities is being ruined.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Câu gốc nói nguyên nhân “poverty and overcrowding” gây hủy hoại đời sống → Dùng “Due to … is being ruined” (do … nên bị hủy hoại). Dịch nghĩa: Do nghèo đói và tình trạng quá tải, cuộc sống của người dân ở nhiều thành phố lớn đang bị hủy hoại.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Do you agree with my view on this issue?
options: A. Did you see eye to eye with me on this issue?
B. Do you view this issue with my agreement?
C. Can you try to agree with me on this issue?
D. Are you in agreement with my view on this issue?
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Thay “agree with st” bằng “to be in agreement with st”. Dịch nghĩa: Bạn có đồng ý với quan điểm của tôi về vấn đề này không?

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. We stayed in that hotel despite the noise.
options: A. Because the hotel is noisy, we stayed there.
B. We stayed in the noisy hotel, and we liked it.
C. Although the hotel was noisy, we stayed there.
D. Without the noise, we would have stayed in the hotel.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: “despite the noise” = “although the hotel was noisy” Dịch nghĩa: Mặc dù khách sạn ồn ào, chúng tôi vẫn ở lại đó.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. He didn't hurry, so he missed the plane.
options: A. If he hurried, he wouldn't miss the plane.
B. If he had hurried, he wouldn't have caught the plane.
C. If he had hurried, he could have caught the plane.
D. He didn't miss the plane because he was hurried.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Dùng câu điều kiện loại 3 (quá khứ không có thật). Dịch nghĩa: Nếu anh ấy đã vội vàng thì anh ấy đã có thể bắt kịp chuyến bay.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. No sooner had James begun his new job than he knew his decision was wrong.
options: A. Just before James took up his new post, he realized that he was not suited for it.
B. As soon as James started working, he realized that his decision had not been a good one.
C. Had James not begun his new job, he would have gone looking for a better one.
D. Since James did not like his new job, he began looking for a better one.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: No sooner … than … = As soon as … (Ngay khi …) Dịch nghĩa: Ngay khi bắt đầu công việc mới, James đã nhận ra quyết định của mình không đúng.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. We almost gave up hope. At that time, the rescue party arrived.
options: A. Only after the rescue party arrived did we give up hope.
B. It was not until the rescue party arrived that we gave up hope.
C. We were on the verge of giving up hope when the rescue party arrived.
D. Had the rescue party not arrived, we wouldn't have given up hope.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Thay "almost gave up" bằng "on the verge of giving up", "at that time" bằng "when". Dịch nghĩa: Chúng tôi đã gần như tuyệt vọng thì đội cứu hộ đến.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Pessimistically speaking, cities will be overpopulated. Traffic will be heavy, too.
options: A. Pessimistically speaking, cities will be overpopulated, and traffic will be heavy.
B. Pessimistically speaking, cities will be overpopulated, for traffic will be heavy.
C. Pessimistically speaking, cities will be overpopulated, but traffic will be heavy.
D. Pessimistically speaking, cities will be overpopulated, or traffic will be heavy.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Hai câu đều mang nghĩa tiêu cực và cùng chiều → dùng “and” để kết hợp. Dịch nghĩa: Nhìn một cách bi quan, các thành phố sẽ trở nên quá đông dân, và giao thông cũng sẽ tắc nghẽn.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Robots can work in situations that are dangerous or harmful for human workers. This is one of the greatest advantages of robots.
options: A. Robots can work in situations that are dangerous or harmful for human workers, which is the only advantage of them.
B. The only difference between robots and humans is that robots can work in situations that are dangerous or harmful for human workers.
C. Because robots can work in situations that are dangerous or harmful for human workers, they have more advantages over human beings.
D. One of the greatest advantages of robots is that they can work in situations that are dangerous or harmful for human workers.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Nối hai câu bằng mệnh đề danh ngữ. Dịch nghĩa: Một trong những lợi thế lớn nhất của robot là chúng có thể làm việc trong những tình huống nguy hiểm hoặc gây hại cho con người.
